title: Winter entries
narrative: The diary keeps moving through ordinary winter life: worship, school, visitors, music, illness, bad roads and snow. On Christmas Day Wynona counted presents and described an evening with Early Earnhart. On December 26 she noted heavy snow and sleet; the following day people were out sleighing.
These entries feel close to daily life, but the twelve linked posts cover a wider period from December into February. The scene gives that span honestly rather than collapsing it into a single day.
quote: Very heavy snow fell last night, and continued all day with sleet, making very good sleighing.
evidenceNote: The scene range is December 1890–February 1891. Beth’s posts include transcribed daily entries, with P063 and P064 providing the details highlighted here. A sleigh photograph in P063 is undated contextual imagery and is intentionally not presented as a record of Wynona’s ride.
